title: A public event hosted by a Space names that Space as its host and its Event organizer

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: 212 of 256 Event nodes in the crawl had no organizer, which Google lists as a recommended Event property and which answer engines use to attribute an event. An event hosted by a Circle already named it; an event hosted by a Space named nobody. getEventHostSpace (lib/spaces/discovery.ts) reads the event's host Space by id on the service side and returns it only when that Space is networked, connected and active; any failure returns null. The Event schema falls back to that Space as an Organization organizer with its /spaces/<slug> address, and the page shows the same Space as the visible host link, so the markup matches what a visitor sees.

verify.note: Fails on main: no host Space reader, no organizer fallback and no visible host link. Passes once all three exist.
